title: Read one document by id
summary: The document get API reads a specific id.
introduction: The document get API reads a specific id. Your task: Request an unused practice id and inspect the result.
learningObjectives: Request an unused practice id and inspect the result.
Explain the example for read one document by id

blocks.text: The document get API reads a specific id. It is different from searching for words across many documents.

Use a local Elasticsearch 8+ instance with Kibana Dev Tools. Paste the HTTP request examples into that console. Use only the cma-books practice index. This website does not connect to an Elasticsearch server.
Read the code step by step

items: The get path addresses one known document rather than running a word search.
The response distinguishes a found document from a missing id.

blocks.text: The response includes found:true and the stored source for Moon Trip when the document exists.

blocks.title: A mistake to avoid
blocks.text: A missing id has a different response. Handle that case instead of assuming every requested id exists.

blocks.title: Your small task
blocks.text: Request an unused practice id and inspect the result.
